gain.rule: DIRECT is the primary arm: per body, the mean over the declared goals of physical_goal_error at this checkpoint minus at the reference; a paired bootstrap over the bodies (10,000 draws, seed 641); line_met when the 95 percent interval's upper end is below 0. Synergy against the reference's synergy has the same arithmetic and never changes line_met. A valid comparison whose interval includes 0 is not met; an interval above 0 is a worsening. Invalid (line_met null): a declared trial missing or held twice on either side, a mandatory start, world, command-state or anchor value missing or differing, a nonfinite arm metric, or another body count, goal list, mode, probe version, frozen set or anchor.

changed_controls.meaning: besides the learned model, what differs between the two runs' search conditions and by how much: the searches of each run keep their own checkpoint's strengths (the 9th number of each handle's command, 0 to 1) and eye command; per body the largest difference over its goals

code.label: the same code as the reference: the script, the normal script and the 6 declared files both runs recorded

settings.label: the same declared settings and smoothing as the reference

checkpoints.meaning: the learned model and every learner and trainer field the frozen set does not replace are each checkpoint's own

keys: world model content (from the saved files)

gain.label: Whole-arm checkpoint performance under the declared search conditions: each planner arm at this checkpoint against the same arm at the reference checkpoint 494,025, from the same frozen starts toward the same frozen goals, both searching around the same anchor (the reference checkpoint's controller proposal), with the strengths and eye command inside each search its own checkpoint's. It does not isolate learned planner improvement: changed_controls lists the strengths, eye command, code and settings that differ from the reference and by how much, and any of them is part of the measured change. Repeated monitoring on this one fixed suite (the 8 frozen starts and 40 frozen goals of checkpoint 494,025) is not a confirmatory generalization claim.

metric_meanings.physical_goal_error: mean over the 25 body handles of (position error / 1.8 cm) squared, averaged over x, y and z, plus the mean over the handles of (turn error / 11 degrees) squared; 0 = every handle on its goal, 1 = every coordinate 1.8 cm off with no turn error
metric_meanings.hand_joint_error_deg: mean absolute difference of the 44 hand joint angles from the goal's, degrees; 0 = exact
metric_meanings.wrist_goal_error_cm: mean distance of the two wrists from their goal positions, cm; 0 = on the goal

gain.difference_sign: this checkpoint minus the reference: below 0 = nearer the goal here

bootstrap.interval: 2.5th to 97.5th percentile of the resampled mean over bodies

compatibility.meaning: pass = the two runs are comparable under the gain rule (one row per declared trial on both sides, every mandatory value present and equal, every arm metric finite); never an ability pass

verdict_rule: the gain rule movement-viewer-fixed-probe-decision-20261018: pass when the direct arm's 95 percent interval of (this checkpoint minus the reference) lies below 0; fail when the comparison is valid and it does not; invalid when the comparison is not valid

controller_command_distance.meaning: this run's controller command minus the other run's from the same start: per body the largest coordinate difference in cm and turn in degrees over the 15 handles the search region bounds, and how many lie outside 1.8 cm per coordinate or 11 degrees

metric_meanings.physical_goal_error: mean over the 25 body handles of (position error / 1.8 cm) squared, averaged over x, y and z, plus the mean over the handles of (turn error / 11 degrees) squared; 0 = every handle on its goal, 1 = every coordinate 1.8 cm off with no turn error
metric_meanings.hand_joint_error_deg: mean absolute difference of the 44 hand joint angles from the goal's, degrees; 0 = exact
metric_meanings.wrist_goal_error_cm: mean distance of the two wrists from their goal positions, cm; 0 = on the goal

difference_sign: this run minus the other run: below 0 = nearer the goal here
